markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Trade_Ring
markers.note: The bartering floor. Two-sided offers, both confirm (Part II 39).

markers.name: INT_Appraiser_s_Stall
markers.note: Tells you what an artifact is actually worth. Charges for the opinion.

markers.name: INT_The_Fence
markers.note: Buys anything, asks nothing, pays badly.

markers.name: INT_Currency_Exchange
markers.note: Credits, Shards and Tokens (Part II 38). Rates move with player activity.

markers.name: INT_Furniture_Row
markers.note: Trailer decor. The healthiest thing in the shop.

markers.name: INT_The_Auction_Board
markers.note: Player-listed rare items on a timer.

markers.name: INT_Weapon_Tinker
markers.note: Applies upgrade paths to weapons you already own (Part II 37).

markers.name: INT_Potion_Row
markers.note: All five potions, marked up. Cheaper to brew them yourself.

markers.name: INT_The_Empty_Stall
markers.note: Any player can claim it for an hour and sell their own finds from it.

markers.name: INT_Rumour_Table
markers.note: NPCs repeat things players have actually done in other realities.

markers.name: INT_The_Locked_Case
markers.note: Contains something nobody in the market will name.

markers.name: INT_Lantern_Line
markers.note: Lighting the whole street opens the night market.
